faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Jamaica?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three straightforward tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is billed only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: How do Ceyo bots work inside Telegram?
faq.a: You can chat directly with individual agents or invite several specialized bots into a Telegram group chat. They collaborate as an operational team, sharing documents, workflows, and long-term memory to resolve complex tasks.

faq.q: Does Ceyo stay online during power or internet outages?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer in secure data centers, operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Your agents keep executing browser tasks, code, and scheduled routines even when your local internet or device is offline.

faq.q: Can Ceyo understand Jamaican contexts and language?
faq.a: Ceyo agents fluently handle English, understand Jamaican Patois terminology and phrasing, and communicate across dozens of international languages. This makes them ideal for coordinating local field operations alongside global client partnerships.

faq.q: Which business applications can I connect to Ceyo?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with more than 1,000 popular platforms including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, Google Calendar, and modern CRMs. Agents can also browse public websites, fill forms, and manage data autonomously.
